_comment: Day 4 - Magic Coin Ice Cream. Target 22-45s (the band that beats both extremes on Shorts retention). Each clip is one ~5s LTX generation. beats[] drives the synthesised SFX.
clips: Close-up: Hoji holds a shiny golden coin up to the camera, eyes wide with excitement, then looks toward a colourful magic ice cream machine. Slight camera push-in.
He pushes the coin into the slot. The machine lights up and whirls, sparkles swirling inside, Hoji leans in close watching.
A giant rainbow ice cream pops out of the machine with a burst of sparkles. Hoji's amazed face fills the frame, mouth open in delight.
He grabs the ice cream and takes a big bite, then hugs it happily and dances on the spot. Bright cheerful ending pose.
Hoji turns back to the camera, waves both hands and laughs, the rainbow ice cream glowing beside him. Final friendly pose for the loop.
